explication: Pokémon Emerald is a Game Boy Advance RPG. The principal workflow is player input through the game loop and overworld, event scripts and encounters, into exploration, battles, collection and progression, with graphics, audio and saved state producing the play result. The tree also exposes contests, Pokédex, storage, trading, multiplayer and Battle Frontier subsystems. Relationships below emphasize sampled controller/storage behavior; several broader routes are inferred from explicit module boundaries, while unsampled internals are not expanded.
